name: HiveMind
notes: Hands-free hears you better: "no queen in this box" isn't a queenless hive, and "very calm", "high" and "brood" come through right.
Bloom: set "This spring is running" to Automatic and it follows this year's USA-NPN Spring Index at your apiary.
Bloom: know your area's bees? Tap "Help check this calendar" on a draft calendar and send your corrections.
Where it rarely freezes (Florida, the Southwest, coastal California), seasonal jobs now follow your bloom calendar.
On a computer, the website uses the whole screen: tabs on the left, Home in two columns.
